title: Per-applicant endpoint's request-validation 400 branches have no test coverage
evidence:
inbound_handler.gleam:
  use json_body <- wisp.require_json(req)
  case decode.run(json_body, remind_applicant_body_decoder()) {
    Error(_) ->
      response_helpers.json_error(
        error_code.ValidationError,
        "Invalid request body",
        400,
      )
...
        "" ->
          response_helpers.json_error(
            error_code.ValidationError,
            "No email provided",
            400,
          )
        _ ->
          case email_parser.is_valid_email(email) {
            False ->
              response_helpers.json_error(
                error_code.ValidationError,
                "Invalid email",
                400,
              )

awaiting_integration_test.gleam helper + every call site passes a valid email:
fn remind_applicant_request(vacancy_id: String, email: String) {
  simulate.request(
    http.Post,
    "/api/v1/vacancies/" <> vacancy_id <> "/remind-applicant",
  )
  |> simulate.json_body(json.object([#("email", json.string(email))]))
}
... remind_applicant_request(vacancy_id, "alice@example.com") ... "due@example.com" ... "done@example.com" ... "returning@example.com" ...
detail: New endpoint adds require_json, decode-error, empty-email and is_valid_email 400 branches; all untested. Every test call passes a valid email, so the validation surface is exercised zero times.
recommended_fix: Add integration cases: POST with empty email, invalid email (e.g. 'not-an-email'), and malformed/missing-email JSON body; assert each returns 400.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence:
Covered scenarios in awaiting_integration_test.gleam: mark_reminder_for_sender_stamps_only_the_named_email_test, mark_followup_for_sender_respects_the_gate_test, single_applicant_remind_reports_stage1_count_test, single_applicant_remind_reports_stage2_count_when_due_test, single_applicant_remind_reports_zero_when_already_fully_reminded_test, single_applicant_remind_cross_tenant_returns_404_test, single_applicant_remind_closed_vacancy_returns_404_test, single_applicant_remind_re_enquiry_sends_stage1_not_stage2_test (6 of 8 handler matrix scenarios; applied-exclusion transitive via bulk followup_excludes_applied_enquirers_test on shared NOT-IN-application SQL).

Uncovered: handler BAD_BODY 400 branches (require_json/decode/empty/invalid-email) at inbound_handler.gleam:667-694.
detail: P0 happy paths (stage1/stage2/scoping/row-gating) 100%. P1 contract matrix ~87.5%: 6/8 scenarios directly tested, applied-exclusion transitive via shared bulk SQL; only BAD_BODY validation untested, holding it under 90%.
recommended_fix: Cover the BAD_BODY 400 branches (empty/invalid email, malformed JSON) to lift P1 to >=90% and clear the gate to PASS.
